                Connection targets for this instance. Credentials stay out of this page by design; use the credential or OAuth values shown by the successful webcodex share or webcodex connect command.
                
        
                
          
                ChatGPT — Developer Mode custom app (MCP)
                
          
                
            —
            
          
                
          
                If Developer Mode is enabled for your ChatGPT workspace, create a custom app, paste this MCP URL, choose the authentication type printed by the CLI, enter the credential from that first successful CLI output, then Scan Tools. This console never exposes the credential or changes ChatGPT-side app permissions.
